Kind kubelet public serving identity trusted with exact SAN/DNS verification
synthetic TLS and ingestion Secrets created without argv values
synthetic HTTPS sink and customer-owned sentinel ready
clean Helm install elven-a
actual Node22 SDK admission and SDK-less Go deployment are disjoint
installed ZIP chart retains exact node affinity and disjoint Beyla selector
actual SDK and Beyla server spans are disjoint, with real Beyla RED histogram
actual rollback removes Beyla worker, preserves identities and SDK delivery

limits: Exception inputs are synthetic OTLP fixtures shaped as Java/Node/Python errors, exported by the actual compiled Collector. This is not evidence that those three SDK applications generated exceptions.
Redis and SQL privacy corpora are synthetic. Actual Redis server/SDK capture, all commands/dialects and universal PII detection are not proven.

Hybrid capture is one Node22 SDK application and one SDK-less Go/Beyla application on one amd64 Kind node, Kubernetes 1.37, kernel 7.0.0-1020-azure with BTF and kindnet. Other kernel/CNI/architecture combinations are not implied.

Beyla retained its existing explicitly consented host baseline: UID 0, six recorded capabilities and seccomp/AppArmor Unconfined; privileged=false, allowPrivilegeEscalation=false. No expanded-capability fallback was added. This is not a restricted Pod Security profile.
Kind default CNI does not prove NetworkPolicy enforcement.

Beyla rollback proves worker Pod termination, preserved Secret/PVC/application Pod UIDs, continuing SDK delivery and no fresh Beyla exercise spans during a bounded 15-second observation. Kernel probe/map purge is NOT_PROVEN.

The ZIP is source-only laboratory material, not ./instalar or a customer-installable kit. Embedded runtimeAcceptance remains NOT_PROVEN because it predates this external experiment; this receipt qualifies only the exact external hash.
The immutable production adapter still rejects hybrid/host/nodes with TEMPLATE_REPACKAGE_REQUIRED. No stable v1.0.1 lock, artifact or installer was changed.
No EIP, Auth Public, shared EO or customer infrastructure was accessed. No image signing, registry publication or release promotion occurred in this laboratory scope.
CI artifacts expire. Original report/manifest and archive hashes identify the checked bytes; embedded summaries are not byte-for-byte replacements.
